text:
elaine (People Ops): Quick FYI — final review handback window is live in Workday, pls read before you start signoffs.
sam (Eng Manager): Thanks! what's the hard deadline?
elaine (People Ops): Hard deadline for manager signoffs is Fri 2024-05-03 23:59 PT. After that reviews lock and only people-ops can reopen.
juan (Product Manager): Re: timezones — can managers in APAC request a 48h extension? We have reviews that need more context.
elaine (People Ops): We can approve exceptions for recurring timezone issues, not for last-minute delays. Request via the review-exceptions form: https://intra/redwood/forms/review-exception
miki (IC): Quick question — are peer feedback uploads required to be attached to the form or is a link ok?
alex (People Ops): Links are fine as long as they are accessible to People Ops and the manager. If it's a doc, set viewer access.
sam (Eng Manager): For calibration, do we need to prepare calibration notes? Any template?
elaine (People Ops): Yes — use the calibration packet template I uploaded to the drive. TL;DR: 1) list calibration candidates 2) short rationale (2-3 bullets) 3) supporting evidence + one ask (promotion / level tweak / no change).
hr-bot: Reminder: calibration slot signups close Tue 2024-04-30 17:00 PT.
juan (Product Manager): How many minutes per person in the canary slot? I have 8 folks.
elaine (People Ops): Canary slots are 30m by default; if you have 6+ we recommend booking a 60m slot and adding "calibration: extended" to the calendar title.
miki (IC): Is the reviewer-load export ready? I want to see who still needs to complete reviews before I ping peers.
alex (People Ops): Yes — export is at /reports/reviewer_load.csv. Example header: 
```
manager,review_count,overdue_count,team_size
sam,3,1,8
juan,0,0,6
```
sam (Eng Manager): can someone give me a quick script to identify direct reports who haven't submitted self-assessments?
elaine (People Ops): Use this curl: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood-internal/reviews/self-assessments?status=missing > missing.json
jq '.[] | .user_email' missing.json
```
juan (Product Manager): Small ask — can People Ops pre-fill one-off accommodations (e.g., LOA) so managers don't have to chase?
alex (People Ops): We can pre-fill if we have documented LOA in HRIS. Please DM me the employee list and we'll mark them in the tracker.
sam (Eng Manager): One last thing — after calibration decisions, what's the expected time to notify ICs?
elaine (People Ops): Finalized ratings must be in the system within 72 hours of calibration close. People Ops will schedule the announcement cadence; managers should have 1:1s within the following week.
miki (IC): Thanks — super helpful. Also: will there be a short FAQ for managers new to calibration?
alex (People Ops): Yes — publishing Manager Calibration Quickstart today: https://intra/redwood/people-ops/calibration-quickstart. It has templates, dos/don'ts, and a short video.
sam (Eng Manager): Awesome, thanks team :tada:
elaine (People Ops): Thanks all — ping us if you're stuck. I'll post a final checklist in #general tomorrow.
